questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: The probability of picking a vowel from a bag of letter tiles is 0.3. What is the probability of NOT picking a vowel?
questions.why: Complementary events always add to 1, so 1 − 0.3 = 0.7.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is the name for the boundary where two tectonic plates move apart from each other?
questions.why: A divergent boundary is where plates move apart, often creating new crust as magma rises between them.

questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C–Am–F–G, which chord is the 'V'?
questions.why: G is the fifth note of the C major scale, making it the 'V' chord. Am is 'vi', F is 'IV', and C is 'I' — the roman numeral just marks the chord's position in the scale.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: What's a healthy way to handle stress?
questions.why: Talking to someone you trust is a healthy coping strategy — bottling up or ignoring stress doesn't resolve it and can make things worse over time.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A spinner has 8 equal sections. What is the probability of landing on section 5, as a fraction out of 8?
questions.why: Each section is equally likely, so the chance of any one section is 1 out of 8, which equals 0.125.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these steps of analysing cause and consequence in history
questions.why: Good historical analysis starts with identifying the event, then works outward to causes, then consequences, and finally judges lasting significance.
